description: Her canonical opener'a karşı NPC (bot eşleşme) tepkileri. Roleplay için decision tree başlangıçları. Her opener için 2 farklı reaction — engaged (ilgili) ve neutral (mesafeli).

responses.engaged: Oh god, where do I even start. A guy once told me my dad must be a baker because I had 'nice buns.' I judged him. Hard.
responses.neutral: Are you judging me right now too? Because if so, you're already doing better than 'nice buns' guy.

responses.engaged: Plan everything, definitely. I have spreadsheets for things I haven't even decided to do yet. You?
responses.neutral: Honestly? Both, depending on the day. Which one are you?

responses.engaged: Yes, obviously. Sweet + savory is a peak combination and I will die on this hill.
responses.neutral: Hard no. I respect the question though, that's a real opener.

responses.engaged: 🫠 — the 'this is fine but barely' emoji. Yours?
responses.neutral: Probably 😐. Just one of those weeks. What about you?

responses.engaged: Storyteller, but only after a coffee. Before that I'm mostly grunts and shrugs.
responses.neutral: I can't tell if you're flattering me or setting a trap. Both?

responses.engaged: I can recite every line from Notting Hill from memory and I think that counts as a personality.
responses.neutral: Memorizing fast food menus. Don't ask why I know KFC's by heart.

responses.engaged: I'd love someone to ask me what I'm currently obsessed with. So — what are you currently obsessed with?
responses.neutral: Honestly, 'what's something you've changed your mind about lately?' Nobody asks me that.

responses.engaged: A flat hike with a coffee stop at the end. That's the deal.
responses.neutral: I respect the elevator move. Are you committing to it or was that just a bit?

responses.engaged: Reading something twice and still failing is the most relatable thing I've heard today. Hi.
responses.neutral: Hi back. What was wrong with the openers you came up with?

responses.engaged: I'll take it on faith. Prove it.
responses.neutral: Bold claim, no evidence. Classic. Continue.

responses.engaged: Statistically true. Hi back — and now we're already winning.
responses.neutral: Statistically also true that the worst openers somehow get the best conversations. Hi.

responses.engaged: I'd actually tell you. Today: a tiny disaster involving coffee and a white shirt. You?
responses.neutral: Depends who's asking. Today, I'd probably tell you. So — how IS your day going?

responses.engaged: Charming: 7/10. Unhinged: 8/10. Net result: doing great.
responses.neutral: You're hitting unhinged harder than charming, but I'm intrigued.

responses.engaged: Thank you. I spent way too long on that bio. Glad it was worth it.
responses.neutral: I appreciate the honest move. What part of the bio specifically?

responses.engaged: I aced a presentation I'd been dreading. Felt great. You?
responses.neutral: Mostly okay week. Tried a new coffee place, it was fine. You first.

responses.engaged: Respect. Hi back — what were you overthinking it into?
responses.neutral: I overthink texts for 3 minutes before sending. We're probably both like this.

responses.engaged: That's my dog Bali. He's a menace and I'm obsessed with him.
responses.neutral: Reading that, you might actually mean it. Tell me about you, then.

responses.engaged: Honestly, I just got accepted into a writing workshop I really wanted. You?
responses.neutral: I've been weirdly into bread making. Like, it's all I think about. You?

responses.engaged: Your bio had me at the line about being bad at karaoke but doing it anyway.
responses.neutral: Honestly? Curiosity. Your profile felt different. We'll see.

responses.engaged: I'm here for the 40% too. Sounds more interesting.
responses.neutral: Where are you getting these numbers from? I want to see your work.

responses.engaged: Hit me with it. I'm prepared to disagree confidently if needed.
responses.neutral: I'll guess: you think I'm 'secretly into something nerdy.' Right?

responses.engaged: Go for it. I'll judge fairly. (No I won't.)
responses.neutral: You go first. That's the rule of going first.

responses.engaged: Lose Yourself by Eminem. I have no idea why. You?
responses.neutral: That's a big question. Can I get a context — first impression song or my-actual-vibe song?

responses.engaged: Honestly, respect. Hi back.
responses.neutral: I'm going to say 'hi' back and also pretend it's intentional. We're a team now.

responses.engaged: Setting low expectations to clear them — I see the strategy. Hi.
responses.neutral: Now you have to prove it. The pressure's on.

responses.engaged: Three days for THAT is rough. But I appreciate the commitment.
responses.neutral: I would have given up after one day. You're stronger than me.

responses.engaged: Same. So — what dumb things are you into?
responses.neutral: Bold of you to assume I'm into dumb things. (I am. Tell me yours first.)

responses.engaged: I appreciate the effort. Hi back. Take your time on the better opener.
responses.neutral: 'Hi' was sufficient. You overthought it but I appreciate it.

responses.engaged: That depends entirely on what you're doing on a Saturday night.
responses.neutral: Low bar for 'more interesting than your Saturday night.' We'll see.

responses.engaged: Wait until you see photo 4. Real damage.
responses.neutral: Mission accomplished, I guess. Tell me about your relationship with pets.
